text: The Patriots head to Chicago for Thursday Night Football carrying momentum from a 26-19 victory over the Jets, with Drake Maye throwing three touchdown passes in that win, though the offense will be without Romeo Doubs after he suffered a shoulder injury on a 42-yard touchdown catch in the first quarter and was subsequently placed on injured reserve. A.J. Brown's return from a four-week absence following a right high ankle sprain proved rocky, as he dropped a career-high three passes against New York, a concerning development as the offense looks to lean on its star receivers against the Bears on a short week. Beat writers are examining how Maye can best attack Chicago's defense off play-action while identifying the key matchups in Johnson's offensive staples, all while the team navigates injury concerns and tries to keep its AFC East momentum rolling in this prime-time contest. The game kicks off Thursday, October 22 at 8:15 PM ET.
